definitions.explanation: The hard white material of an elephant's tusks, formerly used for carvings, piano keys and the traditional Japanese name seal.

examples.japanese: {象牙|ぞうげ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧。
{象牙|ぞうげ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にして⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧{象牙|ぞうげ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{置物|おきもの}→置物：19885_okimono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The ivory ornament my grandfather treasured can't even be sold now.

notes:
Literally "elephant tusk": ⟦{象|ぞう}→象：03328_zou⟧ (elephant) + ⟦{牙|きば}→牙：16154_kiba⟧ (tusk, fang; read げ here).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {象牙|ぞうげ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧ / ⟦{彫刻|ちょうこく}→彫刻：04448_choukoku⟧: an ivory seal / carving
- {象牙|ぞうげ}⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: ivory (the color)
- {象牙|ぞうげ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{塔|とう}→塔：09944_tou⟧: an ivory tower (academic life cut off from the real world)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan was long a major market for ivory because of ⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧ seals and the plectrums of the ⟦{三味線|しゃみせん}→三味線：04464_shamisen⟧. International trade has been banned since 1989.
